text.p: Avatar Industries Ltd said on Friday its wholly owned subsidiary DrillCorp Ltd had agreed to acquire the assets and undertakings of Western Deep Hole Drilling for a total cost of about A$22 million.

Avatar said Western Deep Hole Drilling had similar revenues and margins to DrillCorp and the acquisition was complementary to DrillCorp's existing fleet of mineral drilling rigs, compressors and support vehicles.

Western Deep Hole Drilling was principally focused on servicing the base metals sector of the drilling market and represented a diversification from DrillCorp's gold based drilling activities, Avatar said. Completion is due in October.
